name: Budjut
title: Budjut — Simple Budgeting, Spending Tracking & Financial Health
description: Budjut is a free, open-source budgeting app that helps you track income, expenses, savings, and financial health in one simple dashboard. Built for everyday people, freelancers, and entrepreneurs.
author: Michael Schwartz
